selection_semantics.administrator: all subjects where is_locked is false or null
selection_semantics.ordinary_user: administrator set minus identity-owned restricted subject IDs
selection_semantics.empty_name: omitted; a whitespace-only non-empty legacy name remains visible
selection_semantics.question_count: COUNT of every questions row for the visible subject
selection_semantics.quiz_count: sum of question_count for visible, nonblank-name subjects
selection_semantics.empty_result: HTTP 200 with empty arrays and quiz_count 0
selection_semantics.nullable_is_locked: null is visible for legacy compatibility
selection_semantics.count_type: JSON integer backed by Java long

query_budget.scope: successful authenticated HTTP request without exceptional cleanup

transaction.authentication_authority: read-only request preflight outside the catalog repeatable-read transaction

redis_runtime_writes_by_credential.legacy_bearer: two expiring rate-limit counters per domain-separated HMAC identity pseudonym and exact route; no raw identity ID enters the key and no target Session is created
redis_runtime_writes_by_credential.target_session: target Session access metadata and registry/index reconciliation may be refreshed, plus two expiring subject rate-limit counters
redis_runtime_writes_by_credential.legacy_flask_session_exchange: bounded exchange/replay markers, a new target Session and registry/index entries, plus two expiring subject rate-limit counters

redis_failure_path_runtime_effects.invalid_legacy_flask_session: may consume a bounded pre-verification exchange-attempt counter
redis_failure_path_runtime_effects.invalid_target_session: may delete the stale target Session and unregister its index entry

failure_policy.list_shape: status/error + safe message + subjects=[] + status_code + request_id
failure_policy.metadata_shape: status/error + safe message + empty data subjects/quiz_count + status_code + request_id
failure_policy.approved_difference: P4A-CATALOG-003 replaces legacy exception text with a fixed safe message

cache_transition.reason: do not introduce a cache until identity restriction and catalog question/subject after-commit invalidation is implemented
cache_transition.completion_decision: deliberate always-fresh behavior approved for the migration window; add caching only after every catalog and identity visibility write has complete after-commit invalidation
